title: dzw-2001-united-states-championship
label: ‘Dreamboat’ Devon Tracy

won.source: the promotion's own first Danger Zone broadcast (20 August 2001)

how: Won the tournament final when Demon Deathwish, paid off beforehand, took a single elbowdrop and stayed down for the count.
note: The title's first reign; the promotion's own 3 September update lists the belt vacant with no explanation given for the change.

title: dzw-2001-united-states-championship
label: TJ Masters

won.source: the promotion's own Danger Zone broadcast dated 11 September 2001

how: Outlasted 19 other entrants in a King of the Hill rumble for the vacant title, backflipping to the middle rope as runner-up Alexander Dreamwalker fell to the floor.
note: The last reign recorded in the held run.
